title: 半導体工学
subtitle: Semiconductor Physics and Devices
educationalGoal: Student will: (1) learn semiconductors properties in order to understand the operation mechanism of semiconductor devices.(2) learn pn junctions and metal-semiconductor contacts using the energy band theory studied on “Physical Electronics”. Those are basics on various devices. (3) learn structures and operation mechanism of various diodes, bipolar transistor (PNP , NPN), and field effective transistor (FET).
advice: Using knowledge of the energy band theory and semiconductor fundamental properties studied on “Physical Electronics”, students will learn another aspects of semiconductor fundamental properties and operation mechanism and characteristics of pn junctions, metal-semiconductors contacts, bipolar transistor and field effective transistor. Contents are following; [A] Fundamental properties of semiconductors 1. Density of states and Distribution function 2. Carrier density of impurity semiconductor 3. Drift current and diffusion current [B] Diodes 4. pn junction diode, its I-V characteristics, C-V characteristics, breakdown phenomena 5. MS(metal-semiconductor) contact and Schottky barrier diode [C] Transistors 6. Bipolar junction transistor, its operation mechanism, characteristics 7. MOS (metal-oxide-semiconductor), its structure and properties 8. MOS-FET (field effective transistor), its structure, operation mechanism, characteristics
books: 「基礎電子工学」藤本 晶 (Morikita Publishing Co., Ltd.)
requiredKnowledge: Understanding and knowledge of “Electronic Engineering” and “Physical Electronics. Mathematics, especially differential equation in order to derive equations of device characteristics, and basic physics of motion equations.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain drift current and diffusion current, quantitatively.

Be able to explain operation mechanism of bipolar transistor and field effective transistor.
